text: In February 2018, Penske Media Corporation took a $200 million investment stake from a Saudi government-backed company, publicly identified as the Saudi Research and Media Group (SRMG); the size of any current SRMG holding in PMC is not disclosed.

source.name: TheWrap, via Yahoo: 'Why Does Jay Penske's Media Company Still Have a $200 Million Saudi Stake 9 Months After Khashoggi's Murder?'
source.quote: the $200 million investment stake his company, Penske Media Corporation, took from a Saudi government-backed company in February 2018.
